clips.title: The story
paras: Ironclad Cove is a massive subterranean cavern hidden beneath Westfall, housing an underground shipyard and dock. It serves as the secret construction dock for the Defias Brotherhood's war juggernaught and connects directly to the sea.

Buried at the deepest point of the Deadmines, Ironclad Cove is a monumental sea cavern converted into a fortified dockyard. Here, Edwin VanCleef and the Defias Brotherhood have constructed an enormous warship known as the juggernaught. The cavern features extensive wooden scaffolding, islets, and loading catwalks manned by Defias pirates, deckhands, and overseers. Its existence reveals the true scale of the Defias threat: VanCleef intends not merely to raid Westfall's farmsteads, but to assemble a private naval force capable of bombarding the shores of Stormwind itself.
